Definition: to wriggle, i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound
BiblicalUsage: The waters brought forth abundantly, and so did Israel in Egypt. God said, let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty. Noah was told, be ye fruitful, and multiply, bring forth abundantly in the earth, and the psalm remembers that their land brought forth frogs in abundance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe abundance is God's first blessing on life, because the waters swarmed before the land did. Israel multiplied in Egypt because the same blessing was on them, and the frogs in Pharaoh's chambers were the same abundance turned to judgment. My position is that life multiplies where God speaks, whether it is fish, or Israel, or frogs.
